display.font: FM1 5x7 (app/screen.c). Each character is 6*scale wide and 8*scale tall; the glyph starts floor(scale/2) px below the top. Lowercase is drawn as uppercase.

grid.note: Text at scale 2 fills exactly one cell per character.

screens.name: Midi Monitor
screens.notes:
Default screen at startup; HOME returns here.
Scrolling MIDI monitor, newest at the bottom. Buffer holds 100 events. The bottom row shown is selected (black on blue); scroll to select an older one. SRCH (amber, header columns 13-16) while any search is on.

controls.action: Message rule from the selected row: opens Add Message Rule prefilled (or the existing rule for that input). Lit for notes, CC, PC
Channel rule from the selected row: opens Add Channel Rule prefilled (or the existing rule). Lit for channel messages
Trigger from the selected row: adds a trigger (D1 = the value, D2 0-127, NON 1-127, Fire ENTER) and opens Edit Trigger. Lit for NON, NOF, CC, PC
Turn that search on/off (F#3, G#3, A#3, C#4, D#4); lit while on
Open that search screen (800 ms): Port, Channel, Type, D1, D2
Selected row (NON/NOF/PAT/CC/PC) to Build Message Rule IN; opens it (GLO returns)
Selected row (NON/NOF/PAT/CC/PC) to Build Message Rule OUT; opens it (GLO returns)
